name: com.faremerald.playforge
description: A gameplay framework modelled on Unreal's Gameplay Ability System: abilities, attributes, effects, tags and items, scheduled by ProcessControl and run through TaskSequence. Requires UniTask 2.5.11, which a package cannot declare because it is a git dependency, so add com.cysharp.unitask, pinned to #2.5.11, to the project's manifest.

samples.description: The Demo scene, the Swarm Defender game and the abilities, effects and entities they share. They import together, as they use each other's assets. The Demo needs the Input System package.
Annotated TaskSequence and group process examples, as code to read. They compiled into the runtime until they moved here. The synced sequence examples ship with the Demos, which use them.
